blueprints.description: Contracts for a legal or procurement team: a contract list, a contract page with its parties, obligations and amendments, a timeline of terms and an inbox for what needs review or signature.

screens.name: contracts.list
screens.title: Contracts
screens.description: Every contract with who it is with, when it ends and what it is worth.

screens.name: contracts.record
screens.title: Contract
screens.description: One contract: key facts, parties, obligations, amendments and activity.

screens.name: contracts.timeline
screens.title: Timeline
screens.description: Every live contract on a schedule, in a lane for each counterparty, with its notice dates.

screens.name: contracts.review
screens.title: Needs attention
screens.description: What needs your review, your signature or a renewal decision.

templates.name: ContractsList
templates.description: Every contract with its counterparty, type, end date, value and status, filtered by status, type, owner and date.

templates.name: ContractPage
templates.description: One contract: status, value, days to its end and notice period, its details, parties, obligations and amendments, and its activity.

templates.name: ContractsTimeline
templates.description: Every live contract as a bar from start to end in a lane for each counterparty, with how far through it is and the notice dates that matter.

templates.name: ContractsReview
templates.description: What needs review, signature or a renewal decision: the queue grouped by day with unread told in words, the open message and its history.

templates.name: ContractsQuickCreateContract
templates.description: A short form that creates one contract without leaving the page.
